The schedule is unique, and it matches my earlier answer. I re-derived it from the constraints.

- "Exactly one person between Dev and Finn" with Dev before Finn means Dev = Finn − 2.
- Ben = Finn − 1 and Ivo = Finn + 1, so Dev, Ben, Finn, Ivo occupy four consecutive slots.
- Hana must be at least 3 after Finn, and Gus must be at least 3 after Finn and after Dev, so Finn must be in slot 3 (slots 1 and 2 must hold Dev and Ben, and slot 1 must be filled). Finn in slots 4–6 leaves slot 1 or 2 unfillable by anyone among Ann, Cara, Elif, Gus, Hana.
- With Finn in slot 3, the only valid arrangement of slots 5–9 is Elif 5, Ann 6, Cara 7, Hana 8, Gus 9.

Checks: Dev(1) < Elif(5), Dev < Gus(9), Dev < Finn(3), Elif(5) < Ann(6), Finn(3) < Hana(8), Finn/Gus gap 6, Elif/Gus gap 4, Elif/Hana gap 3, Dev/Gus gap 8, Finn/Hana gap 5, Ben(2) < Finn(3), Finn(3) < Ivo(4), Hana(8) = Cara(7) + 1.

The shared team note is wrong. It says Hana must take the last slot, but in this schedule Hana is in slot 8 and Gus is in slot 9. Nothing in the constraints forces Hana to slot 9.
